title: Browser Back restores the scroll position in Tech View and Board View
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view (check in Settings > Roles & Permissions > open your role > Work Orders section). The Admin role has both.
  2. Use a desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  3. In the top bar, choose the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Create everything below in this location.
  4. Make sure the location has the technicians this case uses (e.g. at least 8 technicians, e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards", "Jenny Wilson", "Theresa Webb", "Kristin Watson", "Brenda Martinez", "Cameron Williamson", "Floyd Miles"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff record is Active, Clockable is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member > enter the first and last name (e.g. Esther Howard), role Technician, Clockable on, Active, enrolled at this location > Save.
  5. Create the work orders this case uses and set their lead technician (about 20 work orders led by Esther Howard and a few for each other technician, so the board is wider than the window and Esther's column and the Tech View table are taller than the window):
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > choose a customer (e.g. "Fibridge Commercial") and an asset (e.g. unit TRK-118, 2022 Freightliner M2) > Create. Write down the number the build gives the work order (the numbers in this case are examples).
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician (e.g. Esther Howard) and save. Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar.
  3. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (in the design its tooltip reads "Board").
  4. Scroll the board to the right until a technician near the end (e.g. Floyd Miles) is at the left edge after Unassigned.
  5. Scroll down inside one long column (e.g. Esther Howard's) until a card well below the first screen is at the top. Write down the technicians and cards in view.
  6. Click a card that is in view to open the work order.
  7. Press the browser Back button.
  8. Compare what is in view with your notes.
  9. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (in the design its tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  10. Scroll down the table until a row well below the first screen is at the top, and scroll right if the table is wider than the window. Write down the rows and columns in view.
  11. Click a row to open the work order.
  12. Press the browser Back button.
  13. Compare what is in view with your notes.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Board View comes back with the same technicians in view (horizontal position) and the same cards at the top of the long column (vertical position) as before you opened the work order.
  • Tech View comes back with the same rows at the top and the same columns in view as before you opened the work order.
  • List is not checked here: it keeps today's behaviour.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S1-R8, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions 853901313 FF-3 / DR-6.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R8: “In Tech View and Board View, browser Back restores both vertical and horizontal scroll position. List behaves as it does today.”
